info.description: One row per outbound affiliate click. Written by the sites' /go redirect, never by hand. Deliberately holds nothing that identifies a person: no IP, no user agent, no cookie or session id — country and a referring path are as far as it goes.

site.description: Which property the click left from. Set by the lifecycle from siteSlug — the redirect knows its own slug but not this row's id.

siteSlug.description: Slug the redirect reported. Kept alongside the relation so a click still says where it came from even if the registry row is later removed.

clickedAt.description: When the redirect was served. Set by the redirect, not by Strapi, so a delayed write still records the real moment.

targetHost.description: Host of the destination, e.g. www.amazon.com. Stored separately from the full URL so per-merchant counts do not require parsing every row.

targetUrl.description: Full destination the visitor was sent to, after affiliate wrapping.

merchant.description: Merchant name or slug as known at click time. A plain string rather than a relation: the merchant row may be renamed or removed later, and this should still say where the click went.

network.description: Affiliate network the link was wrapped for — impact, takeads, amazon, or direct.

offerDocumentId.description: The commerce-offer this click came from, if any. Stored as an id rather than a relation so cleaning up offers never deletes the click history that justifies them.

country.description: Two-letter country from the edge header, if the CDN provided one. Resolved at the edge and never stored alongside the address it came from.

referrerPath.description: Path on our own site the click came from, query string stripped. Enough to see which article earns, not enough to follow a person around.

estimatedValue.description: Click value at the time, from the merchant's EPC. An estimate by construction — real commissions only ever come from the network's own reporting.
